baer-heitev/1:א: (א) You are holy. Saying an entire devotee will not be accepted after reading the scroll. See the name:
baer-heitev/1:ב: Vayehi Noam. After reading the megillah — Minhagim; and likewise Mahari Abuhav who wrote that they say Vayehi Noam — to exclude Kol Bo who ruled one does not say it at all; and what he wrote "and they read the megillah" refers after it, and afterward they make havdalah; and see in Shoneh Halachot in Hagahot Beit Yosef letter 4; and see in responsum Devar Shmuel siman 128.
baer-heitev/2:_: Not in T. Who if they say in his heart does not bring him back from Heaven and he does not return him from the Gemara. It is not until Heaven’s mercy is made, and it is not the glory of Heaven’s people. Customs:
baer-heitev/3:_: Lamenatzeach. Bach wrote in the name of Tosafot Megillah daf 4 that they say the song Mizmor L'Asaf which contains a fall for idolaters.
baer-heitev/4:_: First. Writing and sleeping is a word:
beer-hagolah/1:א: Tur in the name of R' Yehuda.
beer-hagolah/1:ב: There — and he explains: as on other days of the year after the order of Kedushah etc.; and it came only to inform us that we delay havdalah after megillah reading because we take out the day first.
beer-hagolah/1:ג: (ג) When I went the same and it was in the box
beer-hagolah/3:ב: Tur in the name of a responsum he found; and likewise Orach Chayyim.
machatzit-hashekel/1:_: Magen Avraham wrote in Minhagim etc.; and likewise Maharshal in name of Rokeach etc.; in Agudah wrote in name of Rokeach etc.; if so there are two witnesses contradicting each other in Rokeach's words.
machatzit-hashekel/2:א: (s.k. 2) One does not read etc. still servants of Achashverosh. Meaning: in Mordechai's days when the miracle occurred it was impossible for them to say servants of the Name, for they were still servants of Achashverosh; if so we too do not say Hallel.
machatzit-hashekel/2:ב: (ב) I have been waiting for Heaven. And the "Tryon" who is taken on everyone to deal with the same day with many servings and gifts to the Albanians and eating a fertile feast and from others that day in the Gemara in reading its time. This is why Heaven’s Word is revealed to Heaven’s Word:
machatzit-hashekel/2:ג: (ג) And there is no tefillin in the midst of Heaven’s glory, and the glory of the Jews was light and joy and joy. They demand this light. Happiness and sleep is a written word. 6 vertical and body. And this is why he should be shot in his head when reading:
machatzit-hashekel/3:_: Heaven’s Word is the same as Heaven’s Word, and Heaven’s Word is Heaven’s Word, and Heaven’s Word is Heaven’s Word. But in this sense, if they are in a village that they do not have a cm, it is possible for them to find out. But in the USSR, I will have another taste of the Torah as it is written to the Jews, there is light and body, and therefore, Mellin will also be the child of all Jews, and if there is no disconnect between them or not:
magen-avraham/2:_: Written in Minhagim that they say full Kaddish after Maariv prayer before megillah reading; and likewise Maharil in responsum siman 56 Rokeach; and likewise Tosafot daf 4 and Hagahot Maimoniot unlike Levush; and in Agudah wrote in name of Rokeach to say half-Kaddish; and in Masechet Taanit wrote regarding Tisha B'Av they say Shema before Eichah; but Rokeach wrote to say half-Kaddish — end; and Abudraham also wrote half-Kaddish. It appears to me: in these countries where they say full Kaddish, then after megillah reading they say Shema without Titkabel; and possible this is Minhagim's view — siman 559; but not on 15. However if they said it they do not return him as written s.k. 108 unlike Bach.
magen-avraham/3:_: One does not read Hallel in it. For on Exodus we say Hallelu avdei HaMakom velo avdei Pharaoh; but here we are still servants of Achashverosh. In the morning they rise early to synagogue and do not don tefillin until after megillah reading [Matteh Moshe — Minhagim].
magen-avraham/4:_: Marilyn before. I cried and sleep is a word:
mechaber/1:main: Order of Prayer on Purim. Containing 4 paragraphs: After you read the megillah at Maariv say Ve'atah kadosh and if it falls on Motzi Shabbos say Vayehi Noam prior to Ve'atah Kadosh. {Rama: and say Vayitain Licha and say the the Megillah and afterwards Havdalah. (Minahgim)}
mechaber/2:main: Say Al Hanisim during the night and day. {Rama: If you didn't say it you don't repeat (Tur} and Al Hanisim is only said on the 14th but not the 15th. (Beis Yosef in the name of A"Ch and Minhagim} On the night of the 14th even though they haven't read the Megillah you say Al hanisim in Maariv. (Hagahot Maimoniyot Ch. 2)}
mechaber/3:main: We don't say Hallel and Tachnun. {Rama: We don't say Lamatzeach and El Erech Apayim (Minhagim and Beit Yosef in the name of Tosfos)}
mechaber/4:main: We take out the Torah and we read Veyavo Amalek and even though it has 9 verses, the last verse is read twice in order that 10 verses. Then we read the megillah and afterwards the Kedusha. {Rama: Its not the custom to read the last verse twice. {Rama: If there's a Brit on Purim we circumcise the baby before the Megillah.(Mahril and Minhagim)}
mishnah-berurah/1:א: (א) After the Megillah — Magen Avraham inclines that after hearing one recites Shema with "titkabeil" (Eshel Avraham agrees); after "Ata Kadosh" following the Megillah one recites Shema without "titkabeil." Eshel Avraham allows saying "titkabeil" afterward so it covers the prayer in kedushah; at Shacharit one says half-Kaddish after Shemoneh Esreh, then kedushah, then Shema with "titkabeil."
mishnah-berurah/1:ב: (ב) (b) And I will tell you, in the midst of the difference, and the difference is after a holy order like the rest of the year, and what he wrote and the verses of the scroll is about himself:
mishnah-berurah/1:ג: (ג) (c) And then it is distinguished – all that is after the difference in the day since it is:
mishnah-berurah/2:א: (א) (d) At night, even if you were to pray Arabic before the stars were:
mishnah-berurah/2:ב: (ב) (b) There is no return to it - see above in the letter of the S.A. and "in our affairs." And for the miracles in the Gemara, see the man with siman of the SJ:
mishnah-berurah/2:ג: (ג) (b) But not in Tâo, because it does not belong to the same day, nor is it the kind of event and the degradation of who if they say, does not return it to the negotiations there is a little belonging to these days. The volumes are sufficient if they are surrounded by a wall and say about the miracles in the darkness in two days, and it is not the ruling that the depots say. I took a call to the Gemara. There is no way to pray, even though they have been praying for them
mishnah-berurah/3:א: (ז) Hallel — for on Exodus we say Hallelu avdei HaMakom velo avdei Pharaoh; but here we are still servants of Achashverosh.
mishnah-berurah/3:ב: (ח) And one does not fall etc. — and one does not say Lamenatzeach etc. on the two days of Purim because it is written therein tzarah vetzarah — on Purim we do not mention it.
mishnah-berurah/4:א: (א) (c) Arise - up to a generation and say:
mishnah-berurah/4:ב: (ב) (i) And there is no custom to fall, and I am not afraid of ten verses that I am:
mishnah-berurah/4:ג: (יא) And they read the megillah — and bless afterward Harav et riveinu as above siman 692; and all must hear the blessing; and some of the masses say Kaddish then after finishing the megillah — and this is not correct.
mishnah-berurah/4:ד: (ד) (b) Fromlin the baby first and so on, and I will call it the word for the Jews was light and joy and sleep implies a word. And the Gemara said, “This is what it is written about.”
turei-zahav/1:_: and give a qua. This is what Heaven’s Word says, “He is holy, and He is holy, and He is holy, and He is holy, and He is Heaven’s Word, and He is called upon by Heaven’s Word, and He will be blessed with Him.” And he said, “Give you a half-a-half-year-old reading of the scroll and saying that you belong to the previous one in the Gemara, and there will be a blessing from the scroll, and you will be told by the words of Kai and say, ‘Give to you,’ and then it starts another half-a-half-year-old thing that is not a dress
turei-zahav/2:_: If they did not say etc. — Mordekhai siman 200 wrote: days without etc. — it became obligatory on him etc. — end; and his words contradict regarding Chanukah and Purim: first he said they do not return, at end wrote they return — besides opposing Talmud in explaining they do not return; many great ones erase the words on Chanukah and Purim at the end; and Rashal in responsum siman 48 wrote a great one of his generation Mahari Pollak erased veChanukah at the end; and from his custom thus — both are true: Purim evening and morning they do not return him — not better than prayer; but Purim meal which prophets and sages imposed on all Israel as days of feasting and joy more than Shabbatot and Yom Tov etc. — if so not less than Shabbat meal etc. — end; found his conclusion: on Purim there is a distinction — they return only in Purim meal, not evening and morning and Minchah — not in prayer nor Birkat Hamazon except meal time alone. I question this gloss from what Mordekhai wrote in name of Rabbenu Yonah etc. — even though he concludes here Chanukah mention is optional in Birkat Hamazon etc. — implies Yerushalmi had veChanukah; and all the more the first gloss I mentioned that they erased veChanukah and Purim entirely; and in my humble opinion the opposite is in Mordekhai regarding Chanukah — and so it should read: this would say Rosh Chodesh and Chanukah but not Shabbat Yom Tov and Purim which cannot be without eating etc. — Purim has obligation like Shabbat and Yom Tov as written yemei mishteh vesimchah; and Rava said Purim meal eaten at night did not fulfill — implying the meal is obligatory; if so certainly one must eat; and Tur's view seems thus who wrote in 695 they say on miracles in Hodah and did not mention if they did not say they do not return as in 682 Chanukah — rather certainly as he explained; and so for halacha as Rashal in name of Mahari Pollak: in Birkat Hamazon of the meal one must return for on miracles in Purim; but it seems not specifically meal after Minchah but first meal one eats on Purim — for the core reason is meal obligation that day as yemei mishteh vesimchah and insufficient without eating; if so first meal eaten that day fulfills Purim meal thereby; and we need not hang the law on what we call meal after Minchah Purim meal which is added joy — and on this insufficient without eating — so for practical halacha.
turei-zahav/3:_: But not in his stomach. In the name of the Gemara. And I don't know what the ban is about the miracles. And I have done so much that it is not the same day that it is not the kind of event and that it has stopped in darkness, and that it is not the case of the High Court, but that the Parisite should say that even in retrospect, if they say, it comes back from a coin that does not break down in the rest of the world, and that it is not a few days that the rest of Heaven’s name is no matter In these days, I am sure to return if they say they are clear:
turei-zahav/4:_: There is no custom to fall. Heaven’s Word says, “I am not afraid of Heaven.”
